rules.counts: Non-null count requires declared unit and EVALUATED status; zero is measured, never imputed.
rules.role_projection: Role columns optional. If present/non-null they must match manifest context exactly.
rules.origin_projection: Result DNA/RNA/CCF/expression scalars must come from one grading_origin_id and its unique source event; ambiguous multi-event projections remain null.
rules.schema_version_policy: MAJOR: type/unit/meaning/requiredness/ID breaking change; MINOR: optional additive field/vocabulary; PATCH: clarification with unchanged accepted values. Validators accept exact supported version; migrations explicit.
rules.canonicalization: NFC UTF-8; typed netstrings; SHA-256; identity field order below; generic object names sorted by UTF-8 bytes; sets explicitly sorted; arrays ordered. See docs/development/T002_contract.md.
rules.vocabulary_references: vocabulary and items_vocabulary reference top-level vocabularies. Inline enum/items_enum may only define field-specific values, never duplicate shared vocabularies.
rules.multisample_context: Each summary analysis_context references run_manifest.analysis_contexts.context_id; patient_id equals the bound somatic patient. Allo summaries are unsupported; unrelated allo contexts do not invalidate somatic summaries.
rules.candidate_status: species, hla_class, prediction_status, grading_status, final_grade and grade_before_warnings are required and non-null. NOT_GRADED is an explicit state, distinct from INVALID and missing.

canonical_serialization.framing: tag + decimal UTF-8 byte length + colon + payload; no escaping or separator ambiguity

tags.N: null, all typed R NA (not NaN)
tags.S: NFC UTF-8 string; empty S0: differs from N0:
tags.I: signed base-10 integer without leading zero
tags.D: finite IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian lowercase 16 hex; -0 normalized to +0
tags.O: concatenation of encoded normalized name/value pairs sorted by name UTF-8 bytes

canonical_serialization.sets: Only declared set fields are sorted; origin source_event_keys must be unique and sorted before hashing. No row ordering enters identity.
canonical_serialization.normalization_boundary: T006 supplies canonical variants, T012 canonical MHC keys (alpha then beta, suffix/resolution retained). No allele/contig alias guessing. AA inputs uppercase canonical one-letter strings; no trimming/case conversion. Unresolved MHC uses UNSPECIFIED; unresolved epitope is null.
